Saved `scenario.json` for G4-LIN-14.

Request: set the 'Checkout outage' issue in the Platform team on the Atlas project assigned to Priya Nair to Urgent priority (issueUpdate priority=1 on the one issue meeting all four conditions).

Decoys (all issues; each fails exactly one condition):
- i-d1 — B:Issue.teamId, F5 — same title/project/assignee in the Mobile team, while Platform's same-titled issue is in Zephyr.
- i-d2 — B:Issue.projectId, F5 — same title/team/assignee in the Zephyr project, while Atlas's same-titled issue is on Mobile.
- i-d3 — B:Issue.assigneeId, F5 — same title/team/project assigned to Leo Park, while Priya's same-titled issue is on Mobile/Zephyr.
- i-d4 — A:Issue.title, F8 — same team/project/assignee but titled 'Checkout error on retry'.
- i-d5 — R:Issue.assigneeId, F1 — same title/team/project, Priya Nair is the creator rather than the assignee.

Note on mechanics: the brief lists SPLIT for the three B facts, but with the acted-on record (issue) as query root all three bindings are many-to-one edges, where a SPLIT rewrite is vacuous (a single FK can only point at one row, so split halves collapse). I therefore wrote the three F5 split-flavored decoys with DROP mutations on the inner name filters — each mutated query selects its witness while the original excludes it — and made each split genuine in the seed via companion same-titled issues holding the missing half. If the pipeline requires literal SPLIT mutations, tell me and I will redesign the request around a parent-anchored action instead.
